# Abstract

# Life Expectancy Analisys

Here, I re-examine the analysis of Oeppen and Vaupel (2002)

I use gapminder::gapminder_unfilter from tidyverse packages to find the maximun life expectancy for each year and country which had the maximum life expectancy

Here is the code to use to organize the data

```{r}
gapminder::gapminder_unfiltered |>
  group_by(year) |>
  filter(lifeExp == max(lifeExp)) |>
  ungroup() |> select(year, country, lifeExp) |>
  arrange(year) -> sumdat
```

```{r}
sumdat <- gapminder::gapminder_unfiltered |>
  group_by(year) |>
  filter(lifeExp == max(lifeExp)) |>
  ungroup() |> select(year, country, lifeExp) |>
  arrange(year)
sumdat
```
